P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait is used as a dominant human anchor; the right column is a dark panel with only text and numbers, no portrait image.

P05.rationale: There is a named client label ('Martina Ammon') but no actual portrait photo of the client — the right column contains only a dark background with text statistics, leaving a large empty image gap at the top.

P07.rationale: No press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present anywhere on the page.

P10.rationale: No oversized ghost numerals or large decorative quote glyphs are used; the numbers present are data callouts, not decorative typographic elements.

P11.rationale: Real quantified before/after data is shown ('24 Std. → Minuten', '>200.000 €', '4 Kernprozesse') as bold callouts, though no charts or visual data-visualisation frames are used.

P12.rationale: The left column is reasonably filled with structured editorial text, but the large empty dark area at the top-right of the page creates significant under-filling and reduces overall density.

P13.rationale: A subtle paper/cream texture is visible on the left background, but the right panel is a flat dark block with no atmospheric treatment, making the overall texture feel minimal.

P14.rationale: The dark right panel functions somewhat like a scrim area, but there is no actual full-bleed photo being treated — it is simply a flat dark colour block.

P16.rationale: No device, product mockup, phone, laptop, or book is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: No actual photography is used at all, so there is no specific business imagery; the page relies entirely on text and abstract colour blocks, which reads as generic rather than specific.

N08.rationale: The large empty dark rectangle occupying the upper-right quadrant of the page is a significant dead zone with no content, creating purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: There is no instance of text sitting on a busy photo without a scrim; all text sits on flat colour or plain paper backgrounds.
